title: role_from_name's new small_biz/campus branches have no direct unit test
detail: Grep shows zero *_test.odin references to role_from_name; the two new branches are exercised only via harness catalog load (catalog_hash binds raw JSON bytes) + T1 goldens, so a mis-mapping to .None is caught only after a full harness run, not by a focused unit pin.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test asserting role_from_name resolves "small_biz"->.Small_Biz, "campus"->.Campus, and unknown names fall back to .None (the existing role_from_name switch contract).

title: 'Empty source set draws no rng / pre-5.11 fixtures untouched' invariant has no durable unit pin
detail: The re-bless's core determinism claim ('entries whose role has no live terminal spawn nothing and draw no rng — every pre-5.11 fixture is untouched') rests on bless-time log.bin byte-verification + sparse T2 captures. The era-0 analogue test_era0_legacy_no_rng_draws (demand_test.odin:345) exists, but no era-3 empty-source-role test pins the rng stream; T1s cannot detect it (all changed by the fold).
recommended_fix: Add a unit test: era 3 + only residential/content_host topology, snapshot state.rng, step ~50 ticks, assert rng unchanged and no class-0/class-1 spawns from the absent roles.

title: draw_building sprite-less fallback for Small_Biz/Campus is untested
detail: The T2 terminal_types golden always renders with the sprite sheet present (v.sprites.ok), so the primitive-shape fallback (the E9.1 guarantee without the sheet) for the new roles never executes under any test; a regression there would ship silently.
recommended_fix: Add a headless render check (harness) forcing v.sprites.ok=false and asserting distinct non-overlapping pixel counts for residential vs small_biz vs campus fallback shapes.
